title: Theme CSS ships as a hashed static file the site links, not a style tag in every page, after a measurement on a built site

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Measure first-visit and repeat-visit cost; keep inline if first visit regresses. check:build-budget and check:shell-weight stay green. The theme fence holds: member routes never link a theme file.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
